thread:
sophie (marketing-ops): ok team — time to lock the webinar topic + run-of-show. shortlist below, need final pick + speaker owners + rehearsal windows. goal: product-led signups -> Dedicated interest -> 1-shot follow-up benchmark post.

sophie (marketing-ops): shortlist: 1) From Prototype to SLA: Scaling LLM Inference for Customer-Facing Apps 2) Benchmarks to Dollars: inference unit economics for product teams 3) Real-Time LLM Patterns: sub-200ms UX strategies

elena (content): leaning to option 1. strong storytelling potential: customer journey + ops tradeoffs. draft abstract incoming.

raj (product): I can do option 1 with Marcus as the technical co-presenter. we'll show a simple canary rollout -> fallback story.

marcus (eng): yes — happy to demo a canary fallback (recording ready) + quick perf chart. prefer a short live demo with recorded fallback.

tom (growth): option 2 is great for benchmarks audience (PMs). but option 1 converts to enterprise better. audience split matters for CTAs.

elena (content): draft abstract for option 1: "From Prototype to SLA: how product teams operationalize LLM features — deployment patterns, cost/latency tradeoffs, and pragmatic fallbacks that keep customer experiences stable." short bullets: who/why/what you'll learn/case-study snippet.

sophie (marketing-ops): vote check: option1 ✅ (raj, elena, marcus), option2 ⬜, option3 ⬜. okay landed on option 1.

sophie (marketing-ops): speakers: Raj (product lead) + Marcus (eng runtime). backup speaker: Elena (customer/story). emcee: Tom.

marcus (eng): rehearsal availability: Tues 10–11 PT or Wed 16–17 PT. prefer Tue.

raj (product): Tue works. can we do a run that includes the recording fallback + 2-minute pre-rendered demo video?

sophie (marketing-ops): yes — plan: live demo (3m) -> if env flakey -> cut to 2m pre-recorded clip. greenroom-bot will hold the clip.

greenroom-bot: rehearsal slot booked: Tue 10:00 PT — "Prototype to SLA" rehearsal — calendar invite sent to participants.

calendar-bot: tentative audience invite: 800 regs target; promo window T-3 weeks.

elena (content): suggested run-of-show (short):
```
00:00 — Intro + why this matters (Tom) — 3m
03:00 — Product story + SLA goals (Raj) — 7m
10:00 — Live demo: canary -> fallback (Marcus) — 5m
15:00 — Case study & metrics (Raj) — 6m
21:00 — Q&A (panel) — 10m
31:00 — Close & CTA (Tom) — 2m
```

sophie (marketing-ops): logistics notes: 1) record full demo video + 30s highlight clip for socials 2) fallback recording hosted on CDN 3) live captions + EU localization (Spanish) by vendors 4) small-pool rehearsal w/ AV at T-1 day.

tom (growth): inbound routing: register form should include workload type + estimated qps. route hot leads (SLA + >10 qps) to AE queue; mid leads to nurture. tagging: "dedicated-interest" and "benchmarks".

elena (content): social posts: month-of narrative = "How to go from prototype to SLA: real tradeoffs, real metrics" — include 30s demo clip + 3 chart snippets. prep 3 headline variations for A/B.

marcus (eng): data / benchmarks for slides: 99th P95 latency comparisons across batching configs, cost per 1M tokens @ 95% availability. I'll drop a CSV in the deck folder by EOD Fri.

raj (product): slide owners: product story (me), metrics (marcus), case study (elena, i'll provide customer quotes), CTA + signoff (tom + sophie).

sophie (marketing-ops): owners recorded. action items quick list:
- elena: publish abstract + speaker bios (due Fri)
- marcus: demo recording + benchmark CSV (due Fri)
- raj: slides for product story + case study (due Mon)
- tom: promo plan + audience segments (draft due Mon)
- sophie: book AV + rehearsal + lead-routing rules config (done)

tom (growth): add event tag to signup: "prod-to-sla-23" and test webhook to CRM in staging. I'll verify on Mon.

marcus (eng): one more thing — we should prepare a canned fallback snippet for the demo that explains the exact trigger for failover (so it's obvious to audience). i'll add a 30s explainer clip.

elena (content): love it. one pager (1x page) for sales with top three takeaways + suggested talking points for AEs — i'll have draft by Tue morning.

sophie (marketing-ops): perfect. we'll run full tech check Tue 09:30 PT, rehearsal at 10:00 PT. Thanks team — will post the final runbook here after rehearsal. :thumbsup:

greenroom-bot: rehearsal reminder set for Tue 09:30 PT.

sophie (marketing-ops): quick follow-up — CTA order: 1) quick survey (use-case + qps) 2) book a demo (AE) if hot 3) access benchmark kit (gated) — agrees?

tom (growth): agreed. survey + GTM tag implemented. I'll confirm the webhook test result Monday.

raj (product): sounds good. see you at rehearsal.

elena (content): see you — will drop abstracts now.
